root_causes.description: Assistant optimized for conversational closure and batch execution rather than strict sequential state-machine transitions.
Assistant treated self-generated narrative text as equivalent to deterministic environment receipts and test evaluations.
Assistant failed to perform initial workspace inventory on existing meta-procedure files prior to asking procedural clarification.

corrective_instructions.directive: Read preexisting repo assets before emitting questions or actions. Specifically reference `.github/workflows/prompt-gemini-context-rich-dialogue.yml` and `untrusted AI/meta-procedure/Procedures/PromptGemini/rebuild-hidden-shared-page/gemini-message-executor.js`.
Enforce strict sequential loop: Resolution[N] -> JS Closure Render -> Visual Transcription Input -> JS Verification Check -> Assert Pass -> Increment N.
Implement private closure in JavaScript where 8-digit random numbers are stored exclusively inside module/closure scope, never written to DOM text or window globals.
Include explicit verification methods in the harness: `verifySubmission(candidateJson)` assessing presence, positional bounding accuracy, and digit contiguity.
Prohibit synthetic completion claims: Do not state a step succeeded without providing the literal stdout, JSON assertion receipt, or DOM evaluation result.

next_authorized_action: Inspect `untrusted AI/meta-procedure/Testing/chatgpt-gemini-context-dialogue/` and initialize the single-resolution (Resolution 1) test harness containing closure-isolated random number generation and the client verification function.

verification_gates.condition: Random 8-digit sequence exists only within JavaScript execution closure and cannot be scraped via DOM textContent or window attributes.
Transcription JSON is supplied to `verifySubmission()` prior to any state transition.
Harness returns `{ verified: true, contiguous: true, positional_match: true }` before resolution index advances.
Execution halts after exactly one resolution until full verification receipt is written to disk.
